text:
maria-sales: Hey CS team, handing off BlueHarbor (mid-market fintech) — quick context below :wave:

maria-sales: Account summary — 120 seats, Dedicated deployment in us-east-1, onboarding started in preview tenant. Renewal 2026-09-15 (annual). Current ARR: $210k.

maria-sales: Why handing off: sales POC finished pilot. Customer excited but flagged 3 blockers that could delay go-live and affect renewal.

maria-sales: Blocker 1 — SSO + SCIM via Okta not yet validated, customer requires SCIM for provisioning.

maria-sales: Blocker 2 — Network team demands static egress IPs and a TLS mutual-auth path for Private control-plane. They are security sensitive.

maria-sales: Blocker 3 — Finance disputed an overcharge on trial usage last month; they want resolution by next invoice or renewal will be at risk.

maria-sales: Additional notes: using model variant rdx-small-2025 for now, prefix caching enabled, token usage historically spiky during batch exports.

james-cs: Thanks Maria — taking ownership. I’ll run kickoff and 30/60/90 plan. Assigning owners and next steps below.

amanda-se: I can set up the enablement workshop for integrators. Propose Wed Apr 6 @ 11am PT. Will send calendar invite + pre-reqs.

leo-eng: Re: Private control-plane and mTLS — need firewall IP ranges from their infra team. Also there is a known issue with mutual TLS and our older HA proxy in the Dedicated v1 image; will need a config patch. Tagging eng-oncall for scheduling.

sophie-support: Noted on SCIM — support will run a repro with Okta and provide a runbook. If SCIM fails, plan B is manual sync via CSV + automation script (we have a template).

harper-fin: I’ll take the billing dispute. Maria, can you attach the invoice thread and the Stripe charge IDs? Need to escalate if they want a credit.

maria-sales: attaching brief thread and invoice refs in the separate DM (sensitive). Customer expects this closed before Apr 15.

james-cs: Owners + next actions:
- CS owner: james-cs — kickoff, success plan, weekly status updates.
- Enablement: amanda-se — run workshop, dev environment access, sample prompts.
- Support: sophie-support — SCIM validation, runbook.
- Eng owner: leo-eng — network/mTLS changes, firewall IP coordination.
- Finance: harper-fin — billing dispute and invoice reconciliation.

james-cs: Timeline suggestion — kickoff within 72h, SCIM validation within 7 days, network validation within 10 days, credit resolution within 14 days. If any slip, mark renewal risk as HIGH and loop legal.

leo-eng: Quick note: for mTLS we’ll need these ip ranges whitelisted: `35.190.0.0/16, 34.120.0.0/14`. Also share the TLS cert fingerprint process — sample `openssl` commands below:
```
openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in client.crt
```

sophie-support: I’ll run Okta test tomorrow and post results. If SCIM needs a patch, we can hotfix within 3 business days.

amanda-se: Workshop invite sent to customer and CX leads. Shared checklist: org admin, Okta SSO admin, API keys, sample user CSV.

harper-fin: Received invoice refs, will update by EOD. If credit approved, I’ll request billing adj before Apr 12.

oncall-bot: deploy_bot: New patch rollout scheduled for 2026-04-04 02:00UTC targeting dedicated-image:v2.3.1 — affects mTLS handling.

james-cs: Thanks everyone. I’ll post a status summary in this thread after the kickoff. Flagging potential renewal exposure if billing not resolved. :eyes: 

maria-sales: Appreciate it — customer is willing to sign T&Cs but wants the billing item cleared. Please escalate if timelines slip.

sophie-support: will update here after Okta test.

leo-eng: adding ticket ENG-4821 for the mTLS patch, linking to this thread.

james-cs: Closing note: next sync Thurs 11am PT. If any blockers pop up, ping me directly.
